title: Milton Friedman on the free-market case for taxing pollution
summary: A two-minute clip from a 1979 Phil Donahue interview in which Milton Friedman makes the free-market case for taxing pollution. He treats pollution as an externality that can be given a price.
why: HN commenters use it to show that even the best-known free-market economist supported putting a price on pollution.

quote.text: Even Mr. Free Market himself, Milton Friedman, thought a price on pollution was a good idea
